# Channel Sounding capture excerpt — real nRF54L15 silicon, both ends.
#
# Source:  https://github.com/skig/waves  (commit 1b8eb7a), files
#          tests/ini.txt and tests/ref.txt.
# Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Ivan Iushkov. Full text in LICENSE
#          beside this file.
#
# WHAT THIS IS
#
# Two Nordic nRF54L15-DK boards running the Zephyr applications in that
# repository's cs_ini/ and cs_ref/ ran a Bluetooth 6.0 Channel Sounding
# procedure and printed every HCI LE CS Subevent Result to their UART. The
# `Raw step data:` hex below is `result->step_data_buf` dumped verbatim by
# cs_ini/main.c — that is, the *Steps* portion of the HCI event, byte for
# byte as the controller produced it. Nothing in it was written by simble,
# and nothing in it was reformatted by the firmware.
#
# The lines above each hex block are the same event's header fields, as the
# firmware printed them from the parsed event. They are quoted here as the
# expected-value side of the tests: the octets are the input, the printed
# fields are the answer.
#
# WHAT IT WAS CONFIGURED AS  (from the log preamble, identical on both ends)
#
#   mode 2 (PBR), config id 0, mode_0_steps 3, cs_sync_phy 1 (LE 1M),
#   channel_selection_type 0, antenna configuration index 0, TX power 0 dBm,
#   subevent length 16000 us, 75 steps reported per subevent.
#
# One antenna path, so each mode-2 step carries N_AP + 1 = 2 tone entries and
# `Step_Data_Length` is 9 (1 antenna permutation index + 2 x (3-byte PCT +
# 1-byte tone quality indicator)). The initiator's mode-0 steps are 5 bytes
# (they carry the measured frequency offset); the reflector's are 3.
#
#   initiator: 3 x (3 + 5) + 72 x (3 + 9) = 888 bytes   <- matches the log
#   reflector: 3 x (3 + 3) + 72 x (3 + 9) = 882 bytes   <- matches the log
#
# NO GROUND TRUTH. Neither log records the physical separation of the two
# boards, and the upstream repository does not state one. What these bytes
# are an oracle *for* is the wire format and the arithmetic, not the metre.
# For the record, the reference tool's own phase-slope figure over all 62
# paired procedures in the full capture is a median of 0.99 m (min 0.56,
# max 4.85), and its MUSIC estimator sits at 1.17 m; the two boards were
# plainly about a metre apart, but that is an inference, not a measurement.
#
# WHAT WAS EXCERPTED. Procedures 0 and 1 from each end, verbatim and
# unedited, out of the 62 procedure counters the two logs have in common.
# Strip these `#` lines and the `=== ... ===` separators and every remaining
# line is byte-identical to a line of the upstream files.
